title: Only a mask
summary: Looking can be a mask. Only tips travel onward.

cards.text:
A stricter attention uses the query as a mask,
plus additions. A silent query does no work.

The shortcut has to carry tips too.
An analog bypass is a wire that is never quiet.

question.prompt: Which shortcut breaks the event-driven story?
choices: One that carries ordinary numbers around the tip
One that carries the tip itself
One that stays silent when nothing happened
question.why: A real-valued bypass is never a tip and never quiet.
question.simpler: They report 77.1% on ImageNet. The fold-change in energy is their operation count, not a chip on your desk.

question.prompt: A cost that grows with every pair of tokens gets painful on long sequences.
question.simpler: A mask or a running note avoids building the whole table.

recall.question: What replaces the dense score table in spike-driven attention?
recall.answer: A mask made of spikes, plus additions.

deeper.note: Yao and colleagues, NeurIPS 2023. Read the mask, the residuals, and then the energy accounting as an argument about operations.

paper.title: Spike-driven Transformer
paper.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems
paper.section: Spike-driven self-attention and the rearranged residuals.

terms.definition: Attention computed with masks and additions on spikes, so a silent query causes no work.
